name: stellar-mpc-tss-web
description: Stellar MPC-TSS Web Application - Next.js interface for WebAssembly multi-party cryptography on Stellar blockchain
author: Centurion University of Technology & Management (CUTM), Bhubaneswar

scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg && cd .. && mkdir -p public/wasm && cd public/wasm && if [ ! -e pkg ]; then ln -s ../../wasm/pkg pkg; fi
